result:
The workspace now takes its plan from the subscription everywhere; the full test suite passes (617 tests) and the type check is clean. I didn't add new tests for the three reported cases.

- **Plan shown and enforced** (`src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`): every read of a workspace now uses its subscription's current plan and falls back to the plan stored on the workspace only when there is no subscription. That covers the project, issue, seat, storage and webhook quotas, the plan-gated features (like the audit-log export and webhooks) and the switcher and header. Workspaces whose records disagree today are fixed without anyone changing the plan again.
- **Plan changes** (`src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts`): a successful plan change also updates the plan stored on the workspace, so the two stay in step. A refused change still changes nothing.
- **Burst limits** (`src/lib/rate-limit.ts` and the comment, search and invitation services): nothing was telling the rate limiter an org's plan, so it treated every org as Free. These three services now look up the org's plan and pass it in.
- **Trial expiry**: the sweep now only picks up subscriptions still on trial, so workspaces that already chose a paid plan are no longer moved to Free. A plan change makes a subscription active, so running the sweep again changes nothing. Trials that have outgrown the Free limits are still left on their plan.

I also added a `findEffectivePlan` helper in the organization repository that nothing uses now. You can delete it.
